novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a new temporal phenomenon and intervention criterion: “successful jailbreaks exhibit a characteristic delayed collapse” in a token-by-token “refusal commitment trajectory,” rather than refusal being fixed at the prompt boundary. Searches for “refusal direction trajectory generated tokens jailbreak,” “mid-generation jailbreak detection hidden states,” and “dynamic activation steering refusal collapse” identify Arditi et al., Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction (NeurIPS 2024), as the closest mechanistic precursor, while Guiding Giants (2025/TrustNLP 2026) supplies adaptive refusal-vector steering; neither states the elevated-then-decaying collapse signature or collapse-event-triggered repair. Projecting the known refusal direction at successive tokens is a natural measurement extension, but hypothesizing a delayed commitment-collapse relationship that distinguishes successful jailbreaks and serves as the intervention event requires a new core relationship within the established refusal-direction framework, supporting high rather than paradigm-level novelty.
